frozen.rule: After the freeze only corrective changes; any wire change is a new negotiated version with fixtures, docs and a Windows notice.

status: web/backend candidate; gates off; native Windows cases not executed (see acceptance[].native)
authority: Only service-issued Ed25519 grants and endpoint leases authorize; capabilities, features, presence and messages never do.

nativeExtension.negotiation: ext.hello is always a version 1 envelope offering [3, 2, 1]; the endpoint answers one offered version (never higher than offered); every later request and event uses it; no answer or an unknown version means the extension is unavailable (never assumed). Version 3 = version 2 operations + feature localYield + event input.yield.

control.doc: docs/47 (v1, direct calls), docs/48 (v2, streams), docs/51 (profile 2)

releaseAuthority.v2: either active input grant; releases only what this peer pressed under that grant (docs/51 §4.5)

cooperativeInput.negotiation: endpoint declares localYield (enrollment features; extension v3 hello); the helper opts in per peer with input-barrier {epoch: 0} before any input; a peer whose first input has no opt-in keeps the old rule (local input ends remote input)
cooperativeInput.authority: input-state (endpoint → helper) and input-barrier (helper → endpoint) ride on either active input grant of the peer; neither is authority: only the endpoint decides yielding and readiness
cooperativeInput.terminal: Stop, revocation, lock, protected desktop, sensitive native UI, source/peer/lease loss, expiry, replacement, stream end and any authority change while yielded end input authority exactly as before

streamGrants.freshAcquisition: input-request → input-decide: new grantId and nonce, generation strictly higher, the original approvedAt and sessionDeadline, state issued until the endpoint acknowledges; at most 16 per session; a revoked grant is never re-activated.

acceptance.title: Extension negotiation and fallback
steps: Web sends ext.hello (v1 envelope) offering [3, 2, 1].
Repeat with an endpoint configured for v1 only, and with no extension.
pass: v2 endpoint answers version 2 and declares only implemented features; later messages use v: 2. A v3 endpoint answers 3 only when offered (v2 operations + localYield + input.yield).
v1-only endpoint answers 1; the web hides every v2 action.
No answer: the web shows native resources as unavailable.
reject: A v2 request inside a v1 session: invalid-message / unsupported-version.

acceptance.title: Cooperative local input: the host uses their own mouse and keyboard during a session
steps: Negotiate extension v3 (localYield) and declare localYield at enrollment; the helper opts in with input-barrier {epoch: 0} before its first input.
While the helper drags (left held) and holds Shift, the host moves their own mouse, then types on their own keyboard.
The host stops; wait 2 s; the helper moves and clicks again.
pass: Local input works at once; remote input pauses (input-state yielded, the same epoch while the host keeps moving); the session, grants and consent stay unchanged.
The endpoint releases only what the helper pressed (left, Shift); nothing is pressed again by itself after resuming.
Ready only after 2 s without local events, no local key/button held, the endpoint’s own cleanup complete and unchanged authority; input flows again only after the helper’s barrier for that epoch.
reject: Helper input while yielded: yielded. Input sent before the barrier: stale-epoch. A barrier for an old epoch: stale-epoch.
Nothing the helper sends can resume input; old or replayed input-state changes nothing.

acceptance.title: Overlapping and held local input, ownership uncertainty

pass: Yielded for as long as the host holds anything (reason local-held), then 2 s more.

reject: If ownership is uncertain the endpoint stays yielded until neutral; it never guesses.

acceptance.title: Terminal transitions during a yield stay terminal
steps: During a yield: the host presses Stop remote control now; separately, revoke on the service; lock the computer; open UAC; change the shared source; stop the stream; let the deadline pass.
pass: Each ends input authority exactly as without cooperative input (lifecycle suspended/stopped, service revocation); a new session needs ask again, approval and fresh consent.
reject: A barrier or input after any of these: revoked. No yield or readiness ever restores ended authority, extends the deadline, broadens a capability or changes the controller.
